tasks.description: Prisma schema + migration: enums GradeItemSource/ReportCardStatus, models GradingScale, GradeCategory, GradeItem, Grade, TermGradeOverride, ReportCard exactly per PRD FR-1; Course.gradingScaleId, Assignment/Quiz.categoryId (SetNull); back-relations; indexes GradeItem(courseId,termId), TermGradeOverride(termId), ReportCard(termId,status); raw SQL partial unique index grading_scale_one_default. Use prisma migrate, never db push.

Zod validators shared by forms and handlers: bandsSchema (strictly descending, lowest 0, unique letters, gpa stored only), scaleSchema, categoriesPutSchema (weights sum 100, gradingScaleId nullable), manualItemSchema, itemPatchSchema, gradePutSchema, termOverrideSchema (comment <=1000), reportCardPatchSchema, generateSchema, publishSchema, unpublishSchema (reason 1-500). Reuse decimal pattern from validators/assignments.ts.

Pure Decimal grade calculation (no Prisma client import): counted() predicate, applyDropLowest (never drop all), categoryPercent, course weighted mean with renormalisation + Uncategorised weight 0 + points fallback (A8), roundHalfUp1 once at the end, letterFor, effectiveScale, applyOverride (letter-only, percent-only re-derives letter A12), gradeColour. Reuse Decimal/dec/fixed2 from assignments/grading-math.ts. Unit matrix incl. FR-15 golden 78.0 C+, 89.95 -> 90.0 -> A-, AC-2, AC-5, AC-6.

Pure termFor(date, terms, tz, now): containing term by school-local date (schoolToday + getSchoolTimezone), fall back to term containing today, else null (A6). Unit test tz day boundaries, fallback, null.

Gradebook sync module: upsertItemFromAssignment/upsertItemFromQuiz (isVisible only on visibility transition A7, re-place term only when dueAt/availableUntil changes A10, skip+logger.warn when no term), hideItemForSource, deleteItemForSource, syncSubmissionGrade (RETURNED only, excused from GradeExemption, A1), syncQuizGrade/syncQuizGrades (GRADED + resultsVisible + not practice; use existing getStudentQuizScore in quiz/attempt-service.ts, do NOT create a second one; scale to maxPoints). Export pure row builders itemFromAssignment, gradeFromSubmission, gradeFromQuizScore for backfill.

Assignment hooks (one call each): createAssignment/updateAssignment/publishOnce -> upsertItemFromAssignment(tx); deleteOrArchiveAssignment -> hideItemForSource (archive) / deleteItemForSource (hard delete) in same tx; gradeSubmission/bulkReturn/gradeOffline -> syncSubmissionGrade only when RETURNED after write (AC-3); setExemption (both branches) -> syncSubmissionGrade. Add optional nullable categoryId to assignment Zod schemas.

Quiz hooks: updateQuiz (->PUBLISHED or edit of published) -> upsertItemFromQuiz, practice toggle on -> deleteItemForSource; deleteQuiz wrapped in tx -> deleteItemForSource; after submitAttempt/gradeAnswerManually/regradeQuiz commit -> syncQuizGrade(s); releaseResults and maintenance AFTER_CLOSE claim (count===1) -> syncQuizGrades. Add optional nullable categoryId to quiz Zod schemas.

Sync integration tests: return -> Grade, save-without-return -> none (AC-3), exemption on/off, quiz GRADED + IMMEDIATE/AFTER_CLOSE/MANUAL release, practice skipped, archive hides, delete removes, teacher hide survives re-save (A7).

Idempotent backfill: backfillGradebook() batch-loads per course, applies sync row builders with upsert (applyScoringPolicy in memory, no per-student getStudentQuizScore). CLI scripts/gradebook-backfill.ts logs {items, grades} via logger and exits 0. Add package.json script "gradebook:backfill": "tsx scripts/gradebook-backfill.ts" (no dependency changes). Integration test: run twice -> identical counts.
Shared batched loader loadCourseTermData(courseIds[], termId, studentIds?, {visibleOnly}) -> {items, grades, categories, overrides, scales} via findMany with in-filters, grouped in memory (no N+1).
Register notification types grade.posted (STUDENT+PARENT, defaultEmail false) and report_card.published (STUDENT+PARENT, defaultEmail true) in the existing registry.

Grading scales service + routes: CRUD, setDefault in tx clearing other defaults, first scale becomes default, isDefault:false on current default -> VALIDATION_ERROR, delete guarded (default or referenced -> CONFLICT, A11), audit gradingScale.*. GET open to requireUser; writes ADMIN.

Categories service + route: getCategories (assertCanViewCourse), replaceCategories in tx (delete removed, upsert rest, dec(sum).eq(100)), setCourseScale (gradingScaleId in PUT body), audit gradeCategories.replace. GET view / PUT manage.

Gradebook service: getGradebook (assertCanManageCourse, load.ts + Submission{id,isLate}/QuizAttempt{id} lookups, students by last name, grade-calc per student, denormalised payload), createManualItem, updateItem (non-MANUAL: isVisible only), deleteItem (MANUAL only), putGrade (non-MANUAL: comment only FR-9; audit grade.update {old,new}; grade.posted after commit on null->score for MANUAL, A9; returns recomputed StudentTermResult), markAllMissing (now > dueAt, score-null rows only, audit grade.markMissing), putTermOverride (audit termOverride.upsert), exportGradebookCsv via toCsv.

Gradebook API routes (thin withHandler -> Zod -> service -> ok()): GET courses/[id]/gradebook (?format=csv -> text/csv), POST courses/[id]/grade-items, PATCH/DELETE grade-items/[id], POST grade-items/[id]/mark-missing, PUT grade-items/[id]/grades/[studentId], PUT courses/[id]/term-overrides/[studentId].

Student grades service + route: getStudentGrades(user, studentId, termId, courseId?) with assertCanViewStudent, load.ts visibleOnly filtered in query, grade-calc over visible items only, whitelist serializer (no updatedById, no hidden items).

Report card snapshot + access: snapshotSchema (v:1) and pure buildSnapshot(student, courses, computed, attendance, school, scale) per api-contracts ReportCardSnapshotV1; assertCanViewReportCard (ADMIN, student's teachers/homeroom, student/parent only when PUBLISHED, else NOT_FOUND) and canEditHomeroomComment via student-access + Section.homeroomTeacherId.

Report card service: listReportCards (incl. NOT_GENERATED rows + missing-data warnings), generateDrafts (batched load.ts + one attendance getReport, chunks of 100, createMany skipDuplicates + updateMany where status DRAFT), getReportCard, patchComments (DRAFT only, field-level roles, A13), publish (updateMany DRAFT->PUBLISHED, audit, notify report_card.published after commit), unpublish (ADMIN, reason, -> DRAFT, audit {old,new,reason}), listForStudent (PUBLISHED-only for student/parent). Must not import src/server/gradebook writes into ReportCard from gradebook.
Report card API routes: GET /api/report-cards (admin/homeroom list or ?studentId), POST generate, GET/PATCH [id], POST publish, POST unpublish.
Report card integration tests: generate -> publish -> edit grade -> snapshot unchanged (AC-8), regenerate skips PUBLISHED, 7B student gets NOT_FOUND (AC-7), notifications sent, unpublish audited.

Config: courseTabs gradebook (ADMIN, TEACHER) and grades (STUDENT, PARENT); studentTabs grades and report-cards; navigation entries /grades (STUDENT, PARENT), /report-cards (TEACHER), /admin/grading-scales and /admin/report-cards (ADMIN, group Administration).

Admin grading scales page: server page (requireRole ADMIN) + client DataTable list + ScaleEditorDialog (band rows add/remove, inline Zod errors, Default Switch). MUI only, look up every component via mui-mcp first; useToast, ConfirmDialog for delete.

Course gradebook settings page: category rows (name, weight, drop lowest, order), live sum Chip (error colour != 100, Save disabled), course scale Select ('School default' = null). Server page enforces manage access. MUI via mui-mcp.
Category Select in assignment and quiz editors (options from GET /api/courses/[id]/grade-categories, null = none).

Gradebook dialogs: AddManualItemDialog (title, category, max points, DatePicker date, term -> POST grade-items), TermOverrideDialog (percent, letter, comment <=1000 -> PUT term-overrides), ItemStatsDialog (average, median, high, low over counted scores, client-side). MUI via mui-mcp.

GradebookGrid (MIT DataGrid only, no pinned columns): term Select, columnGroupingModel by category, renderHeader (title, due, max, source icon), renderCell (score / EX / M red / - / late AccessTime), isCellEditable MANUAL only, renderEditCell + onCellKeyDown (digits, E, M, Delete, Enter/arrows), processRowUpdate -> PUT with optimistic update, onProcessRowUpdateError per-cell error, synced cell click -> submission grading page / quiz attempt, column menu (hide/show, mark missing, stats), row action override, toolbar Add manual item / Export CSV / Settings, virtualisation, hideFooter. Gradebook server page with manage check. Verify every prop via mui-mcp (useMuiDocs -> fetchDocs) first; stop and report if unreachable.

StudentGradesView (course Cards with percent, letter, gradeColour Chip; Accordion with items and category subtotals, missing/excused flags) and its three hosts: student tab students/[id]/grades, /grades (STUDENT self; PARENT child Select from getAccessibleStudentIds via GradesClient), course tab courses/[courseId]/grades. Server-side access checks on each page.

Print: ReportCardDocument (letterhead, course table, attendance, scale legend, signature lines; renders snapshot only), PrintButton (window.print()), /report-cards/[id]/print and bulk /report-cards/print (PUBLISHED only) server pages; GlobalStyles @page A4 portrait 12mm, @media print hides app shell/buttons, break-after: page per card, break-inside: avoid rows.
Admin report cards page: term / grade level / section filters, DataTable with status Chip and warnings, Generate drafts, Publish all, Print all (ConfirmDialog confirmations, useToast).

Report card review + homeroom list: /report-cards (homeroom TEACHER's sections for selected term), /report-cards/[id] review (ReportCardDocument preview, homeroom/principal comment fields disabled per role or when PUBLISHED, ADMIN Publish / Unpublish with reason Dialog).
Student 'Report cards' tab: list via listForStudent (published only for student/parent, all for admin/teacher), each linking to the print view.

Seed: 'Standard A-F' default scale with descriptors; Homework 30 (drop 1) / Quizzes 30 / Exams 40 for each 7A course; backfillGradebook(); ENG-7A manual 'Oral presentation' graded for all students; Semester 1 teacherComment overrides for MATH-7A and ENG-7A; generateDrafts(S1, 7A).

Playwright: gradebook.spec.ts (teacher keyboard-edits manual grades: digits, E, M, Delete, Enter/arrows; 78.0% C+ visible) and report-cards.spec.ts (admin generates and publishes; parent opens print view with sidebar hidden under print media).
